tools.name: get_site_summary
tools.description: Use when you need an overview of Alshhbaa Brassware's luxury chandelier workshop, Jeddah showroom, 5-year warranty, target spaces, and public agent endpoints. Returns structured company metadata and capabilities.

tools.name: get_contact_channels
tools.description: Use when a user asks how to visit, call, email, or message Alshhbaa Brassware in Jeddah. Returns verified email, showroom addresses, Google Maps links, social profiles, and operating hours.

tools.name: list_public_resources
tools.description: Use when an agent needs to enumerate all addressable Arabic and English Markdown mirrors, llms.txt files, OpenAPI schemas, and discovery URLs on alshhbaa.com. Returns a filtered list of canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_pricing_guidance
tools.description: Use when comparing showroom collections, custom palace/villa commissions, or mosque and hotel lighting tracks. Returns structured pricing packages, scope inclusions, limits, and required quote inputs.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Use when a user wants examples of completed luxury chandelier installations in mosques, royal palaces, hotels, museums, or wedding halls. Returns matching project names, categories, locations, and descriptions.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Use when a user asks specifically about Alshhbaa Brassware's Design, Supply, Installation, or Maintenance services. Returns the detailed service scope, technical coverage, and matching locale text.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_channels, list_public_resources · Private data: get_contact_channels, list_public_resources · Public sink: get_contact_channels.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_channels, list_public_resources · Private data: get_contact_channels, list_public_resources · Public sink: get_contact_channels

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
